title: Measure the canonical FOSB transcript rank in proliferative endometrium
question: Does the median within-biopsy percentile of the canonical FOSB transcript exceed the control median in this four-case, four-control cohort?
scope: A descriptive comparison of eight histologically proliferative eutopic biopsies from GSE315857 using one prespecified transcript, ENST00000353609.
steps: Freeze the cohort, target, reference set, percentile and median contrast before inspecting any target outcomes.
Verify the archived matrix, clinical and technical sample joins and GENCODE v50 target annotation.
Compute and independently check the group medians, their difference and the leave-one-participant-out range.
deliverables: Prospective plan, runnable analysis, regression tests and aggregate descriptive outcome or a source-backed blocker.
acceptance: Require eight distinct assays, four women per study group, complete 8-column matrix and the exact audited source prefix counts.
Require a unique canonical target in 22,961 named transcript rows and the frozen matrix integrity checks.
Report median difference in percentile points and delete-one range without p-values or population-level inference.
